title: Standard Employee Paystub
description: The standard paystub for a regular, ongoing employee. This template calculates standard withholdings (federal/state tax, FICA) and is suitable for most traditional employment relationships with a consistent schedule.

title: Standard Employee Paystub — Modern
description: The same standard employee paystub data in a modern, grayscale layout: a bold header band with your company logo, side-by-side taxes and deductions, and a prominent boxed NET PAY total. Print-optimized in black, white, and gray.

title: Earnings Statement — Classic Ruled
description: The traditional payroll form: serif type inside a hairline-ruled box, a single identity strip across the top, earnings and withholding side by side, and a closing band of year-to-date and current-period totals. Figures print without a currency symbol, the way payroll bureaus issue them.

title: Earnings Statement — Banded Panels
description: A grey-banded payroll form: an outlined company block, employee details in two columns, payment and deduction cards side by side, and year-to-date and net totals boxed at the foot. Shows the state paid family-leave premium as its own deduction line where the employee's state runs one.

title: Earnings Statement — Payroll Register
description: The payroll-register format: an indented identity head, a wide earnings and statutory-withholding ledger with deductions shown as negatives, and employee-paid benefits carried in an Other Benefits and Information panel alongside. Adds a state paid-leave line and a disbursement line naming the payment method.

title: Statement of Earnings and Deductions — Typewriter
description: A monospaced statement set in IBM Plex Mono with italic section headings, outlined employee and pay-schedule boxes, a rule-bracketed earnings and withholding ledger, and a gridded current/year-to-date summary. Adapts its earnings line to the wage type and adds a state paid-leave row where one applies.

title: Independent Contractor Invoice & Earnings Statement
description: Designed for 1099 contractors, this template functions as both an invoice for services rendered and an earnings summary. It highlights gross pay without traditional employee tax withholdings, emphasizing it is not a W-2 wage statement.
